biography.value:
Description

This fairy takes the form of a cat and uses blind and silence on its foes, making it the worst nightmare of all who rely on physical attacks and spells.

Defense

AC 17, touch 14, flat-footed 13 (+3 Dex, +3 natural, +1 dodge)

hp 33 [48] (6d6+12)

mp 14

Fort +4, Ref +8, Will +7

Weakness Water

Offense

Speed 30 ft., Fly 60 ft. (average)

Melee Quarterstaff +3 (1d6)

Special Attacks Telekinetic

Spells Known (FC CL 6th [8th for enfeebling]; concentration +10 [+12 for enfeebling])

At will (DC 14) - bleed, detect magic, mending, message, read magic

1st (DC 15) - Blind, Charm, Mage Armor, Sleep, Wind Armor

2nd (DC 16) - Darkness, Grace, Poison, Silence, Wall Climb

Statistics

Str 10, Dex 16, Con 14, Int 18, Wis 14, Cha 10

Base Atk +3; CMB +3; CMD 17

Feats Combat Casting, Dodge, Improved Initiative

Skills Acrobatics +11, Bluff +8, Diplomacy +8, Escape Artist +11, Knowledge (Geography) +12, Knowledge (Local) +12, Knowledge (Nature) +12, Perception +10, Sense Motive +10, Use Magic Device +8

Gear quarterstaff, top hat;

Languages Common, Mithran, Sylvan

SQ Enfeebling Arts

description.value: All enfeebling spells' effects are increased by a +2 penalty of the appropriate type. All enfeebling spells' durations are increased by 2. All enfeebling spells' caster level are increased by 2. The caster level checks made to overcome a creature's spell resistance is increased by 2 for enfeebling spells.

effect: Use the CL switch for enfeebling spells only. Against SR add a further +2 to the CL check (not to spell DC).
With the enfeebling CL switch enabled: [[1d20 + @spells.primary.cl.total + 2]] versus SR.

description.value: As a standard action, the cait sith may touch up to five items weighing up to 5 lbs., which begin to levitate in its space for the next 5 rounds. Immediately, and once per round as a standard action thereafter, it can launch one item at a target of its choice. The ranged attack is made as if you had thrown the item unless it's ammunition for a weapon, in which case the attack is made as if fired from a heavy crossbow (if a bolt), a halfling sling staff (if a sling bullet), a blowgun (if a blowgun dart), a composite longbow with a +2 Strength rating (if an arrow), an atlatl (if an atlatl dart), or a pistol (if a firearm bullet). A firearm pellet launched by the spell functions as a shuriken. When you launch ammunition with this spell, you don't take a penalty on your attack rolls for lacking proficiency with the ammunition's weapon; you do, however, take the usual -4 penalty for throwing an improvised weapon if you launch an item not intended to be used as a weapon. The attack roll uses your caster level in place of your base attack bonus and your Intelligence or Charisma modifier (whichever is higher) in place of your Dexterity modifier. Range increment and proficiency penalties apply as normal. The attack has an effective Strength bonus, if applicable, equal to the higher of your Intelligence and Charisma modifiers. The spell is discharged when all touched items have been launched. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 2nd level spell (Knowledge: Nature DC 19).
